info.title: NetSentry API
info.description: Implemented identity/workspace API foundation. Monitoring, enrolment, local IPC and service-command schemas are future contracts and are not exposed as API endpoints yet. POST endpoints retain NestJS 201 defaults. Personal workspaces are created at signup; manual PERSONAL creation returns 403. Legacy starter root response is not a product API.

servers.description: Local default; deployment prefix/base URL is configurable.

post.description: Requires current workspace membership with device-registration permission. VIEWER is read-only. Existing installation ownership must match both user and workspace.
